## McGraw Hill, Inc. to Participate in Investor Events


November 24, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Inc--to-Participate-in-Investor-Events-147c51703-2026.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill&index=3&md5=bdd41657df2a6da2e8021ee373401cd4) , Inc. (NYSE: MH; the “Company”) today announced its upcoming participation in the following events:


**AI Webinar with Goldman Sachs** : **** Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Company’s Board of Directors, will participate in a call hosted by George Tong, an equity research analyst with Goldman Sachs. The call will take place on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 1:00 PM ET. The discussion will focus on AI as a growth vector for the Company. For registration, please contact your Goldman Sachs representative orgeorge.tong@gs.com .


**Bank of America Leveraged Finance Conference 2026** : December 1, 2026, Boca Raton, FL – Company management and Investor Relations will present and participate in investor meetings. The presentation is scheduled for 10:10 a.m. EST.


**UBS Global Technology and AI Conference 2026** : December 2-3, 2026, Scottsdale, AZ – Company management and Investor Relations will present and participate in investor meetings. The presentation is scheduled for 3:35 p.m. MST on December 2, 2026.


All presentations will be webcast, with access instructions available on[investors.mheducation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com&esheet=54357907&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.mheducation.com&index=1&md5=9d93ef41c063e6c5ccc760f2594d2df7) . The webcasts will be available for replay on the site for 90 days.


To automatically receive McGraw Hill financial news by email, please subscribe to email alerts on our Investor Relations website at[McGraw Hill, Inc. - Resources - Investor Email Alerts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2Fresources%2Finvestor-email-alerts%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54357907&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc.+-+Resources+-+Investor+Email+Alerts&index=2&md5=aafaa9c848291b0a72067d7973dd3880) .


**McGraw Hill**


McGraw Hill (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages. Visit us at[mheducation.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=mheducation.com&index=4&md5=c1db99a40d4930591945428505c69564) or find us on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fmcgrawhilleducation&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=5&md5=69ca2e3c83c491089b02ffd9dafe24b1) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fmheducation%2F%3Fhl%3Den&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=6&md5=56f5c3d0981417da07653639aa2e2763) ,[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmcgraw-hill-education%2F&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=7&md5=7f13dec8a7bf6e783cae973fb3dcc2f0) or[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fmheducation&esheet=54645743&newsitemid=20261124860604&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=8&md5=9a823321c5575747af732340f6f653fa) .
